counting_note: These are proposed logical cases with declared sub-vectors, not consumed project invocations. Reconcile command, case and rerun counts with the live ledger before execution; do not hide subcases or bundle repeated runs to evade a cap.
gate_note: Parameter/masking, commitment/compiler, public-seed expansion, full VM constraints, native source closure and quantum/security admission are separate unclosed obligations. No case passes those gates by proxy.

cases.name: Checked private entropy request
cases.required_check: Harness injects exactly 32 fixed bytes through an isolated provider seam; confirm the complete seed reaches the encoding generator. This does not test entropy quality.

cases.name: Entropy failure
cases.required_check: Provider returns failure; stage 1 is never entered and no receipt is released. Do not introduce a production deterministic fallback.

cases.name: Encoding replay across stages
cases.required_check: One injected seed reproduces the same encoding stream in stages 1, 2 and 3; a second fixed seed is checked against its own independent expected stream.

cases.name: First seeded query block
cases.required_check: Compare the complete first 32 bytes for two declared fixed seeds with an independent implementation of the documented ASCII/seed/BE64 contract.

cases.name: Query block boundaries
cases.required_check: Compare complete stream slices spanning positions 0, 31, 32, 63 and 64 with independent expectations.

cases.name: Query reseeding
cases.required_check: After partial and full block consumption, seed(d) reproduces a newly constructed generator seeded with d; zero-seed reset is also specified.

cases.name: Discard equivalence
cases.required_check: For fixed counts 0, 1, 31, 32, 33, 64 and 65, discard then draw agrees with sequential reference draws.

cases.name: Counter exhaustion
cases.required_check: A test-only harness reaches the last permitted counter: the last block is emitted once, then refill throws without wrapping. No test control enters the production interface.

cases.name: Retained old negative control
cases.required_check: Show in the isolated old routine that the first block is the same for two fixed seeds; the new routines match their distinct independently calculated vectors. Do not claim an executed forgery.

cases.name: Field acceptance endpoints
cases.required_check: Supply candidates 0 and q-1; both are returned canonically with one consumed candidate each.

cases.name: Field rejection endpoints
cases.required_check: Supply q and 2^254-1 followed by a valid candidate; reject the first two without modular folding and return only the valid candidate.

cases.name: Last permitted success
cases.required_check: Supply 255 rejected candidates then a valid 256th candidate; return it without premature exhaustion.

cases.name: Exact exhaustion
cases.required_check: Supply 256 rejected candidates; exception occurs after exactly 256 draws and output retains a sentinel. No 257th draw or fallback occurs.

cases.name: Stream-error propagation
cases.required_check: Make the candidate engine throw after one rejection; preserve the exception and prior caller output; no default field value is emitted.

cases.name: Domain constants and expected streams
cases.required_check: Compare code, linear and quadratic AES-CTR streams with independent vectors using the specified same key and distinct ivc/ivl/ivq. Distinct outputs do not prove independence.

cases.name: Prover/verifier stream agreement
cases.required_check: For identical public seeds, each prover role and corresponding verifier role consume the same deterministic candidate/rejection sequence.

cases.name: AES engine reseeding
cases.required_check: Initialise, consume, then reinitialise; a fixed seed/IV matches a fresh engine including the first block. Test the active mpz_random_engine, not the unused older vector helper.

cases.name: Active AES cache refill
cases.required_check: Compare output spanning the 16-KiB cache boundary with independent AES-CTR expectations, including candidate draws that straddle a refill.

cases.name: Actual query selection caller
cases.required_check: Run retained portable_sample with the corrected generator for default n=32768 and t=192; check the exact independent index list, uniqueness, range and prover/verifier equality.

cases.name: Experimental stage-label agreement
cases.required_check: Check both entry points use identical experimental labels and compute matching seed vectors for fixed public transcript inputs. This is not full proof-format or statement-binding validation.
